name: Survival Paradise — bounded chat-controlled production task queue
instruction: This queue is a checkpoint, not an autonomous agent. In a new active ChatGPT session, validate against repository HEAD, GitHub Issue #35 and real workflow evidence before acting. Modify task status only based on completed documented evidence.

verified_baseline.last_art_trial_result: PC42M raster sleeve patch visual FAIL; source PNG transfer/readback tested

ready_selection_rule: CHARACTER FIRST: select an executable visual/animation/equipment task; do not fall back to unrelated gameplay while character visual requirements are unfinished. Report real art/tool blocker honestly. Other gameplay only by explicit user permission.

tasks.objective: Test source-first male RIGHT hybrid visual presentation: conceal previously rejected fabricated far forearm while preserving genuine Bone2D and rifle-owned two-grip IK. Do not claim concealed anatomy painted.
tasks.next_action: Inspect actual PC42N Godot five-angle and 32-frame source-fidelity evidence, record independent visual verdict; if worthwhile preserve experimental option, but still require source-faithful elbow surface for final art.
acceptance: Godot 4.7.2 compile/runtime technical PASS
Both weapon hands remain constrained for all 32 frames
Five-angle 3-way comparison improves appearance without introducing unsupported arm materials
Visual verdict explicitly PASS/FAIL/INCOMPLETE; no claim of authored fabric

tasks.objective: Create one genuinely painted concealed male RIGHT support elbow sleeve surface matching approved EAST rifle/unarmed character; do not repeat source-layer or flat-patch failures.
tasks.blocking_reason: Two image tool requests produced unrelated dashboards; local 236x254 raster-patch looked unlike approved cloth. Source-matched image authoring unavailable in last attempt.
tasks.next_action: Inspect availability of a reliable source-conditioned raster editor using real approved reference pixels; author one source-faithful elbow surface and reject at native pixel size if mismatched.
acceptance: Real native RGBA PNG accessible as bytes and SHA verified
Elbow fabric passes visual comparison to original survivor, no fabricated panels/crescents/dark slabs
One-patch Godot 5-angle and 32-frame actual screenshots/GIF, constraints technical pass
Manual-quality visual PASS separately recorded

tasks.objective: Inspect actual playable Survival Paradise game source, independently identify one small safe Android-playable mechanical or control improvement (not dependent on male RIGHT elbow art), implement and verify it.
tasks.next_action: Resume only after core character visual/animation acceptance or explicit new user direction.
acceptance: Real playable-game source modified, not isolated animation prototype
Technical test captured with exact commit and logs
No regression of offline Android and existing game state
Visible screenshots or verifiable gameplay evidence, explicit limitations
tasks.blocking_reason: USER PRIORITY GATE: Character-first. Unrelated playable-game mechanics deferred until a visually acceptable character foundation exists; retain existing design and history.

tasks.objective: Extend gun handling control/state, aiming persistence and reload/recoil logic without promoting rejected arm artwork.
tasks.blocking_reason: First recover and verify current playable-game integration points.
tasks.next_action: After SP-GAME-001, inspect weapon state handlers and implement a bounded testable improvement.
acceptance: Target/aim state and weapon contacts consistent
Actual game runtime tests and source SHA
Art QA not silently promoted

tasks.objective: Develop independent offline mobile movement logic and articulated walk/run integration without using the rejected PC42M patch.
tasks.blocking_reason: Verify existing gameplay movement/animation integration first.
tasks.next_action: Inspect current gait/controls architecture and define one measurable ground-contact/foot-slide regression.
acceptance: Anatomically valid left/right gait loops
Actual Godot 32-frame animation evidence
Playable Android controls preserved

tasks.objective: Build first new signed experimental Android APK from a technically verified playable-game change; document any art limitations.
tasks.blocking_reason: No newer tested playable-game improvement is verified yet.
tasks.next_action: After meaningful playable-game source test, invoke existing Android export CI, verify signed APK in artifact, record source SHA/version code.
acceptance: Actual APK artifact exists and passes package/signature tests
Source/game integration commit and workflow URL verified
Labeled EXPERIMENTAL when visual QA pending

tasks.objective: Approve male RIGHT rifle aiming, firing, recoil, idle and small angle anatomy while preserving original PC42H rig.
tasks.next_action: After native sleeve surface PASS, validate IK/5 angles/32 frames, then extend rifle animation.
acceptance: Both rifle contacts stable
Natural sleeve/forearm continuity
Godot screenshot/GIF reviewed and approved
No PC42H baseline regression

tasks.objective: Complete male LEFT and female RIGHT/LEFT genuine visual character rigs, then pistol/locomotion/equipment art acceptance.
tasks.blocking_reason: Male RIGHT first visual acceptance gate still blocked.
tasks.next_action: Once male RIGHT accepted, implement next LEFT-facing and female rig in small batches.
acceptance: Only two facing directions
Authentic male/female identity
Godot runtime and human-quality visual review per configuration

tasks.objective: Maintain existing independent Issue #35 GitHub watchdog and expiring assistant leases without repeated redesign.
tasks.next_action: Inspect only when latest real run fails or new monitoring bug is proven.
acceptance: Real Actions status and stale leases distinguish ChatGPT vs GitHub
Manual visual QA preserved
No misleading permanent RUNNING state
